description: The frozen validator requires exactly one result-manifest row per assignment, while the postrun recovery contract requires preserving an existing rejected positive row and appending a new-attempt positive row. Append-only retries therefore remain quarantined by the current frozen cardinality check even when the new attempt is otherwise valid.
runner_action: Do not patch frozen authority and do not mutate prior rows; continue fresh retries with immutable attempt identities and preserve this issue for coordinator resolution.
